name: Barbados
people: Where Barbadians and Co-designers design the nation they want to live in.
codesigner: Everyone who shares a vision, a voice or an enterprise here becomes a Co-designer of Perfect Barbados: one of a community of selfless people, at home and abroad, building a nation where every citizen has a decent life.

paras: You are a small island, and the world has long filed you under beach. That reading was always too small. … Picture Perfect Barbados: every tap runs clean, every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and no Barbadian falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
letter.quote: “The island that rewrote the rules for the world can now write the most important clause of all: the promise a nation makes to every one of its citizens.”

mandates.terms: For the Government of Barbados, its development partners and investors. Scope and fees are agreed in writing before any work begins.

capita.pc_text: The yearly cost, per person, of lifting every Barbadian above the Living Line in all seven basic living standards, in 2025 prices.
capita.price_text: Perfect Capita times 282,623 people: the national bill, each year.
capita.est: Perfect Nations estimate in 2025 US dollars, to be confirmed with Barbados. Perfect Capita adds the national poverty lines (Survey of Living Conditions 2016, carried to 2025 prices) to public spending per person on education and health, so nothing is counted twice. The Gap applies FAO’s 2022 food insecurity figure to a population of 282,623.
capita.measures: The strict measures. Food: share not moderately or severely food insecure (FAO). Water: safely managed drinking water where measured; where it is not, basic water, marked as such. Shelter: the lower of safely managed sanitation and the share outside urban slums. Energy: the lower of electricity per person against 1,000 kWh and clean cooking. Education: the lower of children reading by the end of primary school and lower-secondary completion. Health: WHO service coverage index. Livelihood: share above the stricter of the national poverty line and the World Bank line for the nation’s income group. Each figure links to its source.

voices.local: We are looking for the people with real stories from Barbados: the leaders who built something that works, and the keepers of local knowledge who know how their communities live, cope and thrive.

close_lead: Share your vision, suggest a guest, or write to us. Every message receives a personal reply.
sources: World Bank, World Development Indicators: population 2025, land area 2024. Population of record: 282,623.
Barbados Statistical Service, 2021 Population and Housing Census Report (June 2023).
CRFM, Barbados Marine Spatial Planning Profile: exclusive economic zone of more than 185,000 km².
UNEP/GRID-Geneva, Barbados country profile: coastline of about 97 km; reefs in protected areas on the west coast.
World Bank, press release, 20 May 2026: 86% of supply from groundwater; about half of water produced lost; USD 54.7 million programme.
Parliament of Barbados, Ministerial Statement on the Special Feed-in Tariff: 49 MW of solar on the grid, December 2020.
Central Bank of Barbados, Debt-for-Development Swaps, 20 February 2025: BBD 592.7 million loan at 3.5%; IDB and EIB guarantees; 2030 water targets.

Inter-American Development Bank: BA-U0003 (USD 175 million guarantee, Board approval announced 30 October 2026); BA-L1062 (USD 100 million, approved 29 January 2025); BA-O0011 (USD 200 million CCLIP, approved 3 December 2025) and BA-L1069 (USD 80 million first loan).

Coverage of the seven basic living standards: FAO (food, 2022); WHO/UNICEF JMP (water, 2024); 2021 Census (shelter); IRENA and World Bank (energy, 2023); UNESCO (lower-secondary completion, 2024); WHO service coverage index via UHC2030 (health, 2023); IDB and Barbados Statistical Service, Survey of Living Conditions 2016 (livelihood).

Perfect Capita: Perfect Nations estimate of 31 October 2026, from the Survey of Living Conditions 2016 poverty lines carried to 2025 prices by the World Bank consumer price index, and World Bank public spending per person on education (2024) and health (2023). The price of Perfect Barbados is Perfect Capita times the population of record.
